purpose: Treat absent/blank optional reasons only as non-escalating placeholders when no mode is requested or it exactly matches the live standing policy. Preserve all wider-mode validation, approval, filesystem guards and single execution.

patches.after: description: sandboxPermissionsDescription("operation") + " Omit sandbox_permissions and justification for an ordinary operation using the current permissions. Do not fill them with the current mode and an empty reason."

patches.before: description: "Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request."
patches.after: description: "Required for a strictly wider sandbox_permissions request: a non-empty sentence explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request. Omit both escalation fields when no wider access is needed; never send an empty reason for an escalation."

patches.before:
* directory, or the deployment fallback when absent. Validates the escalation argument
	* pairing first.
patches.after:
* directory, or the deployment fallback when absent. Normalize only empty
	* non-escalating placeholders; validate every actual escalation before execution.
